changes: Fix: the thumbnail rule now says six words or fewer (thumbnail A has six), and one diagram caption no longer touches its box edge.
Architecture diagram: shorter node captions so nothing is clipped, labels beside short vertical arrows, and the column labels no longer cut off at the bottom.

Architecture diagram at the top of the hub, with icons, dependency arrows and a dependency table. New Postprod page for the title, description and thumbnail: four title options, a ready description with chapters, tags, and two real 1280x720 thumbnails (text is HTML; the red-tape background was made with fal.ai). Fix: the Changes page no longer lists 'all pages' as cleared when only Script was.
Prod menu: Hyperframes sign-in page (Hyperframes has no web login page: sign in from the CLI or the Studio app, and this project needs no account) and a direct link to hyperframes.studio.

Script rewritten around AI and real-world red tape from your Script page feedback: new wording and voiceover, re-timed to 3:38, spec, checklist, recommendations, kanban, hub and design doc updated. New Postprod pages: Changes (what is changing, with word-by-word script diffs), AGENTS.md (instructions for AI agents, reusable) and Reuse as template. Notes clearing is now per page, so only the Script page notes you sent are deleted.
Fix: the storyboard editor script is now versioned in its URL, so note clearing and other updates reach the browser immediately instead of after the cache expires.

Notes are now deleted once their feedback is implemented: a release made with --clear-notes removes, on every page, the notes written before it, and keeps newer ones. Storyboard notes already implemented in v1.1.0 are cleared. The version is the only record kept.
Postprod: master spec (reusable template) and release checklist, new Postprod menu, blank templates in templates/ for the next video.

Script rewritten from your storyboard feedback: no figures in the hook, goodbye framing, red tape, learn then delegate to AI with a professional, build your system for the next role, Part 2 showcases the stages and the app. Voiceover regenerated and scenes re-timed (196 s of slots, 181 s of voice, no overruns).
Versioning system: every page shows its version and date in a footer, and this changelog lists every release.
Copy-feedback bar on every page, like the storyboard: a feedback box per section, general notes, and one button that copies it all for the chat.
Hyperframes vs Remotion: added a GitHub repo comparison and npm downloads.
Earlier work (scaffold, storyboard, voiceover, menus, comparison pages, speed benchmark) is in the git history; versioning starts here.
